users_06
Tôi đang thuộc phòng ban nào và giữ chức danh gì?

SELECT d.department_id, d.name AS department, j.title AS job FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN departments AS d ON d.department_id = u.department_id LEFT JOIN jobs AS j ON j.job_id = u.job_id WHERE u.user_id = '35337165-e0d0-4dd1-9c67-cc48180363af'
attendances_04
Tháng này so với tháng trước, tôi đi muộn nhiều hơn hay ít hơn?

WITH m AS (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status IN ('LATE', 'LATE_AND_EARLY')) AS cnt, CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', work_date) AS DATE) AS mon FROM attendances WHERE user_id = '35337165-e0d0-4dd1-9c67-cc48180363af' AND is_deleted = FALSE GROUP BY 2) SELECT (SELECT cnt FROM m WHERE mon = CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE) AS DATE)) AS this_month, (SELECT cnt FROM m WHERE mon = CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE) AS DATE) - INTERVAL '1 MONTH') AS last_month
attendances_05
Tổng số giờ làm việc thực tế của tôi trong tuần này là bao nhiêu?

SELECT ROUND(CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (a.clock_out_time - a.clock_in_time)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 3600), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS total_hours FROM attendances AS a WHERE a.user_id = '35337165-e0d0-4dd1-9c67-cc48180363af' AND a.is_deleted = FALSE AND a.work_date >= CAST(DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', CURRENT_DATE) AS DATE) AND a.work_date < CAST(DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', CURRENT_DATE) AS DATE) + INTERVAL '7 DAY'
monthly_timesheets_05
Tháng nào trong năm nay tôi nghỉ không lương nhiều nhất?

SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM from_date) AS INT) AS month, SUM(paid_leave_days) AS total_days FROM leave_requests WHERE requestor_id = '35337165-e0d0-4dd1-9c67-cc48180363af' AND status = 'accepted' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM from_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY total_days DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
monthly_timesheets_07
Giờ OT thực tế và giờ OT được trả của tôi trong tháng này chênh lệch bao nhiêu?

SELECT period_month, total_actual_ot_hours, total_paid_ot_hours, (total_actual_ot_hours - total_paid_ot_hours) AS diff_hours FROM monthly_timesheets WHERE user_id = '35337165-e0d0-4dd1-9c67-cc48180363af' ORDER BY period_year DESC NULLS LAST, period_month DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
monthly_timesheets_08
Những tháng nào trong năm nay tôi đi muộn trên 3 lần?
SELECT period_month FROM monthly_timesheets WHERE user_id = '35337165-e0d0-4dd1-9c67-cc48180363af' AND period_year = 2026 AND late_count > 3 ORDER BY period_month NULLS FIRST
SELECT period_month, late_count FROM monthly_timesheets WHERE user_id = '35337165-e0d0-4dd1-9c67-cc48180363af' AND period_year = 2026 AND late_count > 3 ORDER BY period_month
overtime_records_07
Liệt kê 10 lần OT gần nhất của tôi, mỗi lần mấy giờ và lý do gì?

SELECT approved_date, ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (clock_out_time - clock_in_time)) / CAST(3600 AS DECIMAL), 2) AS hours, reason FROM overtime_records WHERE requestor_id = '35337165-e0d0-4dd1-9c67-cc48180363af' AND status = 'accepted' ORDER BY approved_date DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
overtime_records_10
Tuần nào trong năm nay tôi OT nhiều giờ nhất?

SELECT TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', approved_date), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS week, ROUND(CAST(SUM(CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (clock_out_time - clock_in_time)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 3600) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS total_ot_hours FROM overtime_records WHERE requestor_id = '35337165-e0d0-4dd1-9c67-cc48180363af' AND status = 'accepted' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM approved_date) = 2026 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY total_ot_hours DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
payrolls_04
Giải thích chi tiết các khoản khấu trừ trong lương tháng này của tôi?

SELECT p.period_month, p.period_year, p.base_salary, p.gross_pay, p.insurance_deduction, p.tax_deduction, p.other_deduction, p.total_deduction, p.net_pay, p.status FROM payrolls AS p WHERE p.user_id = '35337165-e0d0-4dd1-9c67-cc48180363af' ORDER BY p.period_year DESC NULLS LAST, p.period_month DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

SELECT base_salary, gross_pay, insurance_deduction, tax_deduction, other_deduction, total_deduction, net_pay FROM payrolls WHERE user_id = '35337165-e0d0-4dd1-9c67-cc48180363af' ORDER BY period_year DESC, period_month DESC LIMIT 1

user_contracts_07
So sánh thời hạn hợp đồng mới nhất với hợp đồng trước đó của tôi?

WITH c AS (SELECT contract_type, contract_start_date, contract_end_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY contract_start_date DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM user_contracts WHERE user_id = '35337165-e0d0-4dd1-9c67-cc48180363af') SELECT (SELECT contract_type FROM c WHERE rn = 1) AS latest_type, (SELECT contract_end_date - contract_start_date FROM c WHERE rn = 1) AS latest_duration, (SELECT contract_type FROM c WHERE rn = 2) AS previous_type, (SELECT contract_end_date - contract_start_date FROM c WHERE rn = 2) AS previous_duration, COALESCE((SELECT contract_end_date - contract_start_date FROM c WHERE rn = 1), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT contract_end_date - contract_start_date FROM c WHERE rn = 2), 0) AS diff_days

Lương cơ bản hiện tại và tài khoản ngân hàng nhận lương của tôi là gì?

SELECT s.base_salary, b.bank_name, b.account_number FROM salaries s LEFT JOIN user_bank_accounts b ON b.user_id = s.user_id AND b.is_default = TRUE WHERE s.user_id = '35337165-e0d0-4dd1-9c67-cc48180363af' AND s.is_active = TRUE

SELECT s.name, CASE WHEN s.shift_id = u.shift_id THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_mine FROM work_shifts s CROSS JOIN (SELECT shift_id FROM users WHERE user_id = '35337165-e0d0-4dd1-9c67-cc48180363af') u ORDER BY s.name

SELECT sc.day_of_week FROM work_shift_schedules sc JOIN users u ON u.shift_id = sc.shift_id WHERE u.user_id = '35337165-e0d0-4dd1-9c67-cc48180363af' AND sc.is_working = FALSE ORDER BY sc.day_of_week

WITH r AS (SELECT period_year, period_month, avg_manager, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY period_year DESC NULLS LAST, period_month DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM performance_reviews WHERE user_id = '35337165-e0d0-4dd1-9c67-cc48180363af') SELECT (SELECT avg_manager FROM r WHERE rn = 1) AS this_period, (SELECT avg_manager FROM r WHERE rn = 2) AS last_period, (SELECT avg_manager FROM r WHERE rn = 1) - (SELECT avg_manager FROM r WHERE rn = 2) AS diff

WITH r AS (SELECT period_year, period_month, avg_manager, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY period_year DESC, period_month DESC) AS rn FROM performance_reviews WHERE user_id = '35337165-e0d0-4dd1-9c67-cc48180363af') SELECT (SELECT avg_manager FROM r WHERE rn = 1) AS latest, (SELECT avg_manager FROM r WHERE rn = 2) AS previous
performance_scores_01
Chi tiết điểm từng tiêu chí đánh giá của tôi kỳ vừa rồi?

SELECT pr.period_year, pr.period_month, pr.status, ps.criterion_text, ps.self_score, ps.manager_score, ps.note FROM performance_scores AS ps JOIN performance_reviews AS pr ON pr.review_id = ps.review_id WHERE pr.user_id = '35337165-e0d0-4dd1-9c67-cc48180363af' AND pr.period_year = (SELECT MAX(period_year) FROM performance_reviews WHERE user_id = '35337165-e0d0-4dd1-9c67-cc48180363af') AND pr.period_month = (SELECT MAX(period_month) FROM performance_reviews WHERE user_id = '35337165-e0d0-4dd1-9c67-cc48180363af' AND period_year = (SELECT MAX(period_year) FROM performance_reviews WHERE user_id = '35337165-e0d0-4dd1-9c67-cc48180363af')) ORDER BY ps.sort_order NULLS FIRST

SELECT criterion_text, self_score, manager_score FROM performance_scores WHERE review_id = (SELECT review_id FROM performance_reviews WHERE user_id = '35337165-e0d0-4dd1-9c67-cc48180363af' ORDER BY period_year DESC, period_month DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY sort_order

SELECT criterion_text, manager_score FROM performance_scores WHERE review_id = (SELECT review_id FROM performance_reviews WHERE user_id = '35337165-e0d0-4dd1-9c67-cc48180363af' ORDER BY period_year DESC, period_month DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY manager_score ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

SELECT a.asset_code, a.name, a.serial_number, a.specs FROM assets a JOIN asset_assignments aa ON aa.asset_id = a.asset_id WHERE aa.user_id = '35337165-e0d0-4dd1-9c67-cc48180363af' AND aa.status = 'active'
